## Browser Automation

Always use Vercel's `agent-browser` CLI for all browser needs — visual verification, screenshots, form testing, scraping, and page inspection. Do NOT use Playwright MCP, puppeteer, or manual curl-based scraping when browser interaction is needed.

**Workflow:** open → snapshot → interact → re-snapshot

```bash
agent-browser open <url>
agent-browser snapshot -i          # Interactive elements with refs
agent-browser click @e1            # Use refs from snapshot
agent-browser fill @e2 "text"
agent-browser screenshot out.png   # Visual verification
```

Key commands: `open`, `snapshot -i`, `click`, `fill`, `type`, `press`, `select`, `screenshot`, `get text/url/html`, `wait`, `scroll`. Use `--session <name>` for parallel browsers. Use `--headed` for debug.

# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Overview

Astro static site deployed to AWS (S3 + CloudFront + Route 53). Uses Caddy as a local reverse proxy in dev. Outputs to `dist/` for S3 upload.

## Commands

```bash
npm install                    # Install dependencies
```

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use a 1-hour Anthropic prompt-cache TTL, so effectively every allowed delay (the runtime clamps to [60, 3600]) wakes up with your conversation context still cached. There is no cache cliff inside that range to pace around, and scheduling extra wakeups just to keep the cache warm is pure waste — never do that. (If the session enters usage overage, later requests drop to the 5-minute TTL; don't try to track or preempt that — the guidance here stays the same.)

Match the delay to what you're actually waiting for:

- **Actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about** (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue): pick the delay from how fast that state actually changes. A CI run that takes ~8 minutes deserves one ~480s check, not eight 60s ones.
- **The long fallback heartbeat** (something else — a Monitor, a task notification — is the primary wake signal): 1200s+, so quiet wakeups stay rare.
- **Idle ticks with no specific signal to watch**: default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop still checks back regularly, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Don't think in cache windows — think about what you're actually waiting for.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

<result>I found all five answers. The main finding is that the "Atelier Blush" direction (cream, dusty rose, gold, Cormorant Garamond) is already applied in the code. A newer brand report recommends a different direction ("Postcards Between Us"), but it says no direction has been chosen. Nothing requires legacy pages to match the old site pixel for pixel; they can be restyled as long as the structural build checks still pass.

## 1. Brand identity

**Name and people.** The site is "Lovely Sunday" (production: `https://lovelysunday.co`). It is not an artist or a shop. `brand-research/lovely-sunday-brand-identity.json` describes it as *"A photography-led personal style journal and editorial archive created by best friends Aileen and Rory, spanning outfit stories, lookbooks, and travel diaries."* The main idea is "Style worth remembering." Its personality pairs are "Intimate, not insular / Polished, not precious / Romantic, not nostalgic / Playful, not frivolous."

**Colours in use now.** These come from `_Resources/atelier-blush-redesign-plan.md` and are live in `src/styles/vars.css`:
- Light mode: `--color-primary: #C9A6A0` (dusty rose), `--color-base: #1A1A1A` (warm black), `--color-border: #E5DDD5` (warm sand), `--color-bg: #FAF7F2` (cream), `--color-accent: #C4A265` (gold), `--color-bg-subtle: #F3EDE6`
- Dark mode: `#D4B5AF`, `#E8E2DC`, `#3A3530`, `#171514`, `#D4B280`, `#1E1C1A`
- The plan says: *"warm minimalism / quiet luxury — inspired by brands like Céline and The Row ... photography-forward presentation with generous whitespace, refined typography."*

**Typography in use now** (same plan and `vars.css`):
- `--font-display: 'Cormorant Garamond'` for headings, with thin weights: h1 at `font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: 0.04em`.
- `--font-serif` (Iowan Old Style or Palatino) for body text.
- `--font-sans-serif` (Avenir Next or Futura) for navigation and labels, styled `letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 300`.
- `--radius: 0.2rem`.

**Competing brand directions** (in `brand-research/`, not yet adopted):
- **The Sunday Edit:** Paper `#F5F0E8`, Carbon `#171614`, Powder Rose `#CFA8A0`, Oxide `#8C4A3C`, Hairline `#D8D0C5`. It has a *"magazine cover: one edge-to-edge portrait ... vertical index"* and is closest to the current palette.
- **Postcards Between Us (the recommended one):** Letter Paper `#FFF8EC`, Postmark Blue `#24465A`, Lipstick `#C94C58`, Sky Wash `#A8C9D1`, Sunprint `#E7B955`. It uses paired offset frames and a "postcard back" reveal on cards. The report says: *"Recommended for discussion; no territory has been selected."* It also warns: *"The existing blush-and-gold direction may already have stakeholder commitment."*
- **Dress the Day:** Vanilla, Ink Plum, Persimmon, Pool and Petal, with lively, moving type.

**Tone** (`VOICE_AND_TONE.md`):
- "A personal style diary, not a magazine editorial."
- The mix is 40% intimate diary, 25% fashion analysis, 20% aspirational elegance and 15% playful confidence.
- It should feel "Warm, conversational, intentional ... Sophisticated but approachable."

**Mood boards** in `_Resources/`: `moodboard-1-atelier-blush.html` (the chosen one), `-2-editorial-noir`, `-3-copper-jardin` and `-4-lazy-sunday`, each with a `.png` screenshot. There are also 189 reference images in `_Resources/_Inspiration-Ref/`, a logo in `_Resources/Animated SVG Brand/lovely-sunday.svg` and `.html`, and source logo files in `_Resources/Brand/*.ai`/`.eps`.

## 2. Design system, motion and explicit "do not" rules

There is no formal design system document. The tokens in `src/styles/vars.css` plus `_Resources/atelier-blush-redesign-plan.md` act as one.

**Motion** (plan, Step 10):
- Cards fade in on scroll: `opacity 0 → 1` and `translateY(20px)` over `0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`, staggered by 0.1s.
- Images zoom slightly on hover: `scale(1.02)` over 0.6s with the same curve.

Two limits: `node_modules` and `dist/` are missing from this worktree, so I couldn't build or list which legacy routes come out as `gallery`, `list` or `page`. And one likely image-offset bug (8a) comes from reading the CSS, not from rendering it.

Before reading the numbers below: **`html { font-size: 62.5% }` makes 1rem = 10px** (`src/styles/components/global.css:258`). Several scoped styles look like they were written for 16px.

---

## 1. Routes: template, sections, wrapper classes

All pages render inside `Layout.astro` like this: `body.site-wrapper > div.site-content-shell > Header` → `main#site-main.site-main > div#swup.transition-fade > <slot/>`, followed by `Footer` outside the shell.

| Route | Type | Chain | Sections / wrapper classes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/` (`src/pages/index.astro`) | **Legacy mirror, overridden** | `LegacyHtmlPage` with a rewritten `view` (lines 14-30), plus `InstagramGrid` passed in the slot | `article.legacy-page.legacy-page--home` → `header.legacy-page-hero.has-media` → `.legacy-page-copy` (`p.legacy-page-eyebrow`, `h1`) and `figure.legacy-page-hero-media` → `section.legacy-page-links` (2 CTA pills) → `section.legacy-page-gallery` of `figure.legacy-page-frame` → after `</article>`: `section.instagram-grid` (9 posts) |
| `[...slug]` (every captured URL except `/`, `/about-lovely-sunday`, `/contact-lovely-sunday`; lines 7, 15-16) | **Legacy mirror** | `LegacyHtmlPage` | Same structure, modifier `legacy-page--gallery`, `--list` or `--page`. Covers `/lookbook`, `/daily-diary`, `/cart`, `/search`, `/shop`, `/lookbook/looks/*`, etc. |
| `/lookbook-double/looks/[slug]`, `/lookbook-single/looks/[slug]` | **Legacy mirror** | `LegacyHtmlPage` | 5 slugs each (`src/data/legacyLookbook.ts:1-15`). `src/middleware.ts` rewrites `/lookbook//looks/x` and `/lookbook/looks/x` to these. |
| `/about-lovely-sunday` | New Astro (hand-written) | `Layout` directly, `breadcrumbs={false}` | Images come from `capture/page_json/about-lovely-sunday-d298690e81.json`. `article.about-page` → `img.hero` → `.about-inner` → `.brand` (logo) → `.content-grid` (`section` + `aside` with 3 `section.panel`) → `.hidden-media` (display:none) |
| `/contact-lovely-sunday` | New Astro | `templates/Contact.astro` → `PostLayout` → `Layout` | `article.contact-form.page-template` → `ImageBlock` (`div.post-content-image > img.kg-image`) → `div.post-content-body` (`h1`, Markdown, `form` using `.row.gtr-uniform` / `.col-6.col-12-xsmall` / `ul.actions`) → `InstagramFeed` |
| `/work/[slug]`, `/news/[slug]`, `/sold/[slug]` | New Astro | `templates/Work.astro` → `PostLayout` → `Layout` | `article.post-content` → `p.post-content-excerpt` → `ImageBlock` → `div.post-content-body` (Markdown + `InstagramGrid`) → slot `after`: `div.post-link` with two `LinkBlock` (`a.post-nav-link.prev/.next`) → `InstagramFeed` |
| `/contact/thanks` | New Astro | `Layout` | `article.post-content.page-template.no-image > div.post-content-body > section.thank-you` |
| `templates/Page.astro`, `templates/List.astro` | — | — | **Not used by any route.** `List` is the only place `PostCard` / `.post-feed` / `.page-head` render. |

**How legacy pages are rendered** (`src/lib/legacy-pages.ts`):
- No raw HTML is injected anywhere. At build time, `loadLegacyPages()` (332-385) reads `capture/manifests/all_urls.txt` (55 URLs), each `capture/page_json/*.json`, and the matching `capture/raw_html/*` (with a path-traversal guard at 355, and `<noscript>` stripped).
- Cheerio extracts plain data: gallery images from `#page .sqs-gallery-design-autocolumns-slide img, #page img` using `data-image`, `data-src`, `src` and `data-image-dimensions` (175-200), paragraphs as text (202-222), and links (224-262, internal only, at most 12).
- That data becomes a structured `LegacyView {kind, eyebrow, title, description, heroImage, images, links, paragraphs}`.
- `kind` (297-304): `home` for `/`; `gallery` if more than one gallery image; `list` if more than 3 links; otherwise `page`.
- `LegacyHtmlPage.astro` then re-renders that data with new markup, so it is effectively sanitised by reconstruction.

---

## 2. Scoped `<style>` blocks inside .astro files

| File | Lines | What it defines |
|---|---|---|
| `src/pages/about-lovely-sunday.astro` | 79-194 | `.about-page { margin: -4rem -1.5rem 0 }`, `.hero` (16/9, cover), `.about-inner { max-width: 1100px; padding: 2rem 1.2rem 4rem }`, `.brand`, `.content-grid` (1.5fr/1fr, gap 2.5rem), **bare `h1`/`h2`/`h3`/`p`/`input`/`button`** rules, `.panel`, `.profile`, and a stack at ≤800px |
| `src/components/InstagramFeed.astro` | 43-98 | `.instagram-feed { max-width: 1120px; padding: 0 1rem 2rem; margin: 3rem auto 0 }`, header `h2` at `clamp(1.4rem, …, 2rem)` / weight 500, `.instagram-grid` (2 columns, 3 from 720px), `.instagram-card` (aspect-ratio 1, **no border-radius**), 1.03 scale on hover |
| `src/components/InstagramGrid.astro` | 34-90 | `.instagram-grid { width: min(100%, 1180px); margin: clamp(4rem, 8vw, 7rem) auto 2rem }`, `h2` in `--font-display` at `clamp(2.4rem, 4vw, 4rem)`, `.instagram-grid__items` (3 columns, 2 at ≤640px), `.instagram-grid__card` (1/1, **radius 0.8rem**), first card spans full width at 1.6/1 on mobile |
| `src/pages/contact/thanks.astro` | 21-29 | `.thank-you` grid, centred, `padding: 2rem 0` |
| `src/components/DevelopmentBar.astro` | 36-135 | Dev-only floating panel, self-contained |

Global component CSS imported from components: `PostCard.astro:2` imports `post-card.css`, and `LegacyHtmlPage.astro:3` imports `legacy-page.css`.

Not imported anywhere: `legacy-gallery.css` (targets old `.sqs-*` markup). `hamburger.css` is imported through `content.css:19`, but no hamburger markup exists.

---

## 3. Client-side JS and animation hooks

- **Swup** (`Layout.astro:182-194`, bundled module): `new Swup({ containers: ["#swup"], cache: true, animationSelector: "[class*='transition-']", plugins: [new HeadPlugin()] })`. It isn't an Astro integration; `astro.config.mjs` only has react, sitemap, llm-enhancements and robots-txt.
- **Swup CSS** (`src/styles/components/animations.css:5-28`):
  - `.transition-fade` runs a `slideUp` keyframe from `translate3d(0, 4vh, 0)` on load.
  - `html.is-changing .transition-fade` transitions opacity; `html.is-animating .transition-fade { opacity: 0 }`.
  - Note: this `transform` on `#swup` makes it a containing block for any `position: fixed` element inside it.
- **Scroll reveal** (`Layout.astro:196-217`, `is:inline`): an IntersectionObserver (threshold 0.1, rootMargin `0px 0px -40px 0px`) adds `.is-visible` to `.post-card`. It returns early under `prefers-reduced-motion`. The CSS is at `animations.css:31-51` (hidden and translateY(20px) until `.is-visible`, with delays on nth-child 2 and 3).
  - **Gap:** it runs once on first load and is never re-bound after a Swup navigation, so `.post-card`s on a page reached through Swup would stay at opacity 0. This is latent today because nothing renders `PostCard`.
  - **Gap:** Storybook doesn't run this script but does load `animations.css`, so the PostCard stories probably render invisible.
- **Theme** (`Layout.astro:145-161`): sets `data-theme="dark"` from localStorage. There is no toggle in the UI.
- **AnnouncementBar**: inline `onclick` removes the `<aside>`. The component isn't used on any page.
- **DevelopmentBar**: dev-only collapse, copy and Storybook-ping script.
- There is no hamburger menu, no scroll listener, and no `.reveal` or `data-animate` hook. The only other animation is the footer SVG stroke-draw (`site-shell.css:153-176, 242-254`).

---

## 4. Header and Footer

**Header** (`src/components/Header.astro`):
- Markup: `header.site-head > div.site-head-container > a.site-head-logo > img` plus `nav.site-head-nav[aria-label=Primary]` with plain `<a>` elements.
- Nav items: Discover → `/lookbook`, Archive → `/daily-diary`, About → `/about-lovely-sunday`, Contact → `/contact-lovely-sunday`.
- Active state is `aria-current="page"`, set at build time (line 24). CSS (`site-shell.css:77-117`): opacity 0.6, then accent colour on hover or current, with an `::after` underline that scales in.
- **Bug:** Contact's `section` is `"/contact"` (line 7), so it never matches `/contact-lovely-sunday`. It only lights up on `/contact/thanks`.
- **Bug:** the header sits outside `#swup`, so `aria-current` goes stale after Swup navigation.
- Layout: `.site-head-container { max-width: 1320px; padding: 0 var(--site-shell-gap) }`, grid `auto 1fr`. At ≤700px the logo is centred and the nav becomes 4 equal columns.
- Nav font-size is `1rem`, which is **10px**.
- `Header.stories.ts` describes a "centered wordmark", but on desktop the logo is left-aligned.

**Footer** (`src/components/Footer.astro`):
- Markup: `footer.site-foot > div.site-foot-logo` (logo SVG inlined through `set:html`) + `div.site-foot-inner > .site-foot-brand (strong, small ©) + small.site-foot-bio + nav.site-foot-nav`.
- Links: Discover, Archive, Contact, "Instagram ↗" → `instagram.com/lovelysunday`. **No About link**, and the handle differs from the `_lovelysunday` used everywhere else.
- Inner width is `max-width: 1320px`, matching the header. There's hover styling but no active state.
- **Positioning quirk:** `.site-foot-logo` is `position: absolute; inset: 0`, but `.site-foot` isn't positioned. Its containing block is therefore `body.site-wrapper`, so the logo is centred over the whole page, behind `.site-content-shell` (z-index 2, opaque background). `--footer-reveal` (`site-shell.css:4`) is defined but never used, so a reveal-footer effect looks unfinished.

---

## 5. PostCard, InstagramGrid, InstagramFeed, ImageBlock

- **PostCard** (`PostCard.astro:19-31`):
  - Markup: `article.post-card.{with-image|no-image}.post > a.post-card-link` wrapping everything, so **the whole card is the link**. Inside: `div.post-card-image-wrap > img.post-card-image` (alt = title, lazy) and `div.post-card-content > h2.post-card-title`.
  - No figure/figcaption.
  - Aspect ratio comes from CSS: `0.8/1` (`post-card.css:12`), `16/9` for `.post-feed .post-card:nth-child(5n+3)` (18-20), `0.9/1` at ≤900px.
  - Links go to `/${slug}/`.
  - Not used on any route.
- **InstagramGrid** (`InstagramGrid.astro`):
  - Markup: `section.instagram-grid > header.instagram-grid__header (h2, p)` + `div.instagram-grid__items > a.instagram-grid__card > img`.
  - Each card is an external link (`target=_blank`), square via CSS, alt = caption or a fallback. No figure.
  - Used on `/` (after the legacy article) and inside `.post-content-body` on work, news and sold pages.
- **InstagramFeed** (`InstagramFeed.astro`):
  - Markup: `section.instagram-feed > div.instagram-feed-header (h2 + a)` + `div.instagram-grid > a.instagram-card > img`.
  - **It reuses the class name `.instagram-grid`** for a different element than InstagramGrid's `<section>`. Scoping stops the two colliding today, but it's confusing.
  - Rendered by every `PostLayout`.
- **ImageBlock** (`ImageBlock.astro`): `div.{className ?? "post-content-image"} > img.kg-image`. No figure/figcaption, no width/height. Alt is the page title (set in `PostLayout.astro:45`).
- **Legacy frames** (`LegacyHtmlPage.astro:94-116`) are the only place using `<figure>`: `figure.legacy-page-frame.is-{full|half}-span.orientation-{portrait|landscape|square|unknown}[data-orientation]`, with an `img` that has `width`/`height` and `data-image-dimensions`.
  - Pairing logic (32-46): two consecutive portraits become `is-half-span`.
  - None use figcaption. Alt comes from the capture, falling back to "Lovely Sunday gallery image".
- **Global:** `img { border-radius: 10px }` (`content.css:373`) rounds every image, including logos. Other radii vary: 0.8rem on InstagramGrid cards, none on InstagramFeed cards, `var(--radius)` = 0.2rem on PostCard, 1.25rem on legacy frames, `14rem 14rem 1.25rem 1.25rem` on the home hero.

---

## 6. Homepage section by section (`index.astro` → `LegacyHtmlPage`)

1. **`header.legacy-page-hero.has-media`**, 2-column grid `minmax(0, .82fr) minmax(340px, 1.18fr)`, min-height `min(680px, 100vh - header - 7rem)` (`legacy-page.css:67-71`).
   - `.legacy-page-copy`: `p.legacy-page-eyebrow` "A personal style journal", `h1` "Romantic style, lived beautifully." (`clamp(4.4rem, 7.5vw, 8rem)`, `max-width: 10ch`), then the description `p` (max 40ch).

content.content:
agent-browser - fast browser automation CLI for AI agents

Usage: agent-browser <command> [args] [options]

Core Commands:
  open <url>                 Navigate to URL
  click <sel>                Click element (or @ref)
  dblclick <sel>             Double-click element
  type <sel> <text>          Type into element
  fill <sel> <text>          Clear and fill
  press <key>                Press key (Enter, Tab, Control+a)
  keyboard type <text>       Type text with real keystrokes (no selector)
  keyboard inserttext <text> Insert text without key events
  hover <sel>                Hover element
  focus <sel>                Focus element
  check <sel>                Check checkbox
  uncheck <sel>              Uncheck checkbox
  select <sel> <val...>      Select dropdown option
  drag <src> <dst>           Drag and drop
  upload <sel> <files...>    Upload files
  download <sel> <path>      Download file by clicking element
  scroll <dir> [px]          Scroll (up/down/left/right)
  scrollintoview <sel>       Scroll element into view
  wait <sel|ms>              Wait for element or time
  screenshot [path]          Take screenshot
  pdf <path>                 Save as PDF
  snapshot                   Accessibility tree with refs (for AI)
  eval <js>                  Run JavaScript
  connect <port|url>         Connect to browser via CDP
  close                      Close browser

Navigation:
  back                       Go back
  forward                    Go forward
  reload                     Reload page

Get Info:  agent-browser get <what> [selector]
  text, html, value, attr <name>, title, url, count, box, styles, cdp-url

Check State:  agent-browser is <what> <selector>
  visible, enabled, checked

Find Elements:  agent-browser find <locator> <value> <action> [text]
  role, text, label, placeholder, alt, title, testid, first, last, nth

Mouse:  agent-browser mouse <action> [args]
  move <x> <y>, down [btn], up [btn], wheel <dy> [dx]

Browser Settings:  agent-browser set <setting> [value]
  viewport <w> <h>, device <name>, geo <lat> <lng>
  offline [on|off], headers <json>, credentials <user> <pass>
  media [dark|light] [reduced-motion]

Network:  agent-browser network <action>
  route <url> [--abort|--body <json>]
  unroute [url]
  requests [--clear] [--filter <pattern>]
  har <start|stop> [path]

Storage:
  cookies [get|set|clear]    Manage cookies (set supports --url, --domain, --path, --httpOnly, --secure, --sameSite, --expires)
  storage <local|session>    Manage web storage

Tabs:
  tab [new|list|close|<n>]   Manage tabs

Diff:
  diff snapshot              Compare current vs last snapshot
  diff screenshot --baseline Compare current vs baseline image
  diff url <u1> <u2>         Compare two pages

Debug:
  trace start|stop [path]    Record Chrome DevTools trace
  profiler start|stop [path] Record Chrome DevTools profile
  record start <path> [url]  Start video recording (WebM)
  record stop                Stop and save video
  console [--clear]          View console logs
  errors [--clear]           View page errors
  highlight <sel>            Highlight element
--- set ---
agent-browser set - Configure browser settings

Usage: agent-browser set <setting> [args]

Configures various browser settings and emulation options.

Settings:
  viewport <w> <h> [scale]   Set viewport size (scale = deviceScaleFactor, e.g. 2 for retina)
  device <name>              Emulate device (e.g., "iPhone 12")
  geo <lat> <lng>            Set geolocation
  offline [on|off]           Toggle offline mode
  headers <json>             Set extra HTTP headers
  credentials <user> <pass>  Set HTTP authentication
  media [dark|light]         Set color scheme preference
        [reduced-motion]     Enable reduced motion

Global Options:
  --json               Output as JSON
  --session <name>     Use specific session

Examples:
  agent-browser set viewport 1920 1080
  agent-browser set viewport 1920 1080 2    # 2x retina
  agent-browser set device "iPhone 12"
  agent-browser set geo 37.7749 -122.4194
  agent-browser set offline on
  agent-browser set headers '{"X-Custom": "value"}'
  agent-browser set credentials admin secret123
  agent-browser set media dark
  agent-browser set media light reduced-motion

input.content:
# Three design reviews + implementation: consistency, grid, hierarchy, motion ## Context Lovely Sunday (lovelysunday.co) is an Astro 5 static site: a photography-led personal style journal in the "Atelier Blush" direction (cream `#FAF7F2`, dusty rose, gold accent `#C4A265`, Cormorant Garamond display). Commit `6a5f1ce` redesigned the homepage and nav page-by-page, so the shared system is now inconsistent. Verified problems: - **No token system.** `vars.css` has colors and fonts only. No spacing, type, container, radius, or motion tokens. Breakpoint vars exist but are unused (and `actions.css:58` uses one inside `@media`, which is invalid CSS). - **Five container widths.** Header/footer 1320px; `.legacy-page`/Instagram/guide line 1180px; `.post-feed`/`InstagramFeed` 1120px; about page 1100px; prose 720px→740px. `.site-main` has fixed `1.5rem` side padding while header/footer use `clamp(1rem,2vw,1.8rem)`. No two edges line up. - **Two rem assumptions.** `html { font-size: 62.5% }` (1rem = 10px), but newer CSS was written for 16px: legacy body copy is **10.2px**, home hero paragraph 10–12px, eyebrow/nav/footer nav 10px (9px on mobile), footer bio 9.5px. Post body copy is 20px. Same site, half and double the intended size. - **Hierarchy conflicts.** Four competing h1 specs, four h2 specs (two request weight 500, which is not loaded), eight uppercase-label tracking values (0.04em–0.24em), work/news/sold pages have no h1, contact h1 sits below the hero. - **Motion is effectively absent and inconsistent.** The only scroll reveal targets `.post-card`, which no live route renders, and it never re-binds after Swup navigation. The real gallery (`.legacy-page-frame`) has no reveal. The Swup wrapper runs a 0.9s/4vh slide on every load with no reduced-motion guard. Ten different transition durations and six easings are in use. Footer logo stroke-draw is positioned relative to `body` and hidden behind the content shell. - **Build-time bug.** `postcss-custom-properties({ preserve: false })` inlines `var()` inside `content.css`, silently breaking dark mode for global/buttons/forms and any new token cascade. - **Dead/duplicate CSS.** `legacy-gallery.css` imported nowhere; `hamburger.css` has no markup; `.post-content`, `.post-content-excerpt`, `.post-content-body`, `.page-head`, `.post-link` each defined 2–3 times; `.post-content-image` keeps a `translateX(calc(50vw - 50%))` after its margins were reset. **Outcome:** one token layer, one container, one type scale with clear roles, one motion language (shared ease/durations, scroll reveal on real content, consistent hover), verified with before/after screenshots at three widths. ## Interpretation and decisions (made, not open) - **Three reviews = three lenses, cumulative:** (1) layout/grid/consistency, (2) typography/hierarchy, (3) motion/interaction. Each: screenshot pass → findings file → implement → re-screenshot. - **Keep 62.5% root.** The ghost/content layer depends on it. Fix values through tokens instead. - **Container = 1180px for header, footer, and content.** Three of four surfaces are already 1180; the sticky logo should share a left edge with the hero eyebrow. Galleries may break out to 1440px. - **Remove `postcss-custom-properties`** from `postcss.config.cjs`. All targets support custom properties. - **About hero comes inside the container** with the standard large radius (it is the only edge-to-edge photo on the site). - **Footer logo watermark: fix and play on scroll**, shortened to ~3s. - **CTA pills keep mixed case** at `--text-sm` sans (their own "pill" role). The uppercase label spec applies to nav, footer nav, eyebrows, section labels, post-card titles. - **Work/news/sold** (placeholder pottery content) get the shared system (h1, prose width, one Instagram section) but are not removed. - **Brand direction unchanged.** Palette, fonts, arch hero, pill CTAs stay. ## Files (critical) - `src/styles/vars.css` — token layer - `src/styles/components/legacy-page.css` — home + all legacy routes (main visual surface) - `src/styles/components/site-shell.css` — header/footer - `src/styles/components/global.css` — body + heading scale + role classes - `src/styles/components/animations.css` — rewritten - `src/layouts/Layout.astro` + new `src/scripts/reveal.ts` — Swup init, reveal, aria-current - `src/components/LegacyHtmlPage.astro`, `InstagramGrid.astro`, `InstagramFeed.astro`, `Footer.astro`, `Header.astro`, `PostLayout.astro`, `PostCard.astro` - `src/pages/about-lovely-sunday.astro`, `src/templates/Contact.astro`, `src/templates/Work.astro` - `src/styles/content.css`, `layout.css`, `components/buttons.css`, `actions.css`, `forms.css` - `postcss.config.cjs` Build-gate constraints (must hold): ≤1 `

` per page; keep `.legacy-page-gallery`, `.legacy-page-frame`, `.is-half-span`, `img[data-image-dimensions]` and the pairing logic in `LegacyHtmlPage.astro:32-46`; no class containing `sqs-` or `agentation`; Storybook prop names unchanged. --- ## Step 0 — Setup, baseline, and build-time fixes 1. `npm install` (node_modules is missing in this worktree). Start `npm run dev:astro` → http://127.0.0.1:4321. 2. Create `.context/review-{1,2,3}/{before,after}/`. 3. `postcss.config.cjs`: remove `postcss-custom-properties`. `content.css`: drop `@import "vars.css"` (Layout already imports it first) and `@import "components/hamburger.css"`. Delete `hamburger.css` and `legacy-gallery.css`. Fix `actions.css:58` (`@media (max-width: 480px)`) and `forms.css:19` (`margin: 0 0 var(--space-2) 0`). 4. Baseline screenshots with the protocol below into `.context/review-1/before/`. ## Step 1 — Token layer (`vars.css`) Add to `:root` (keep colors/fonts; keep `--height`, `--margin`, `--radius` as aliases; --space-2: 0.8rem; --space-3: 1.2rem; --space-4: 1.6rem; --space-5: 2.4rem; --space-6: 3.2rem; --space-7: 4.8rem; --space-8: 6.4rem; --space-9: 9.6rem; --section-gap: clamp(4.8rem, 8vw, 9.6rem); --block-gap: clamp(2.4rem, 4vw, 4rem); # Three design reviews + implementation: consistency, grid, hierarchy, motion ## Context Lovely Sunday (lovelysunday.co) is an Astro 5 static site: a photography-led personal style journal in the "Atelier Blush" direction (cream `#FAF7F2`, dusty rose, gold accent `#C4A265`, Cormorant Garamond display). Commit `6a5f1ce` redesigned the homepage and nav page-by-page, so the shared system is now inconsistent. Verified problems: - **No token system.** `vars.css` has colors and fonts only. No spacing, type, container, radius, or motion tokens. Breakpoint vars exist but are unused (and `actions.css:58` uses one inside `@media`, which is invalid CSS). - **Five container widths.** Header/footer 1320px; `.legacy-page`/Instagram/guide line 1180px; `.post-feed`/`InstagramFeed` 1120px; about page 1100px; prose 720px→740px. `.site-main` has fixed `1.5rem` side padding while header/footer use `clamp(1rem,2vw,1.8rem)`. No two edges line up. - **Two rem assumptions.** `html { font-size: 62.5% }` (1rem = 10px), but newer CSS was written for 16px: legacy body copy is **10.2px**, home hero paragraph 10–12px, eyebrow/nav/footer nav 10px (9px on mobile), footer bio 9.5px. Post body copy is 20px. Same site, half and double the intended size. - **Hierarchy conflicts.** Four competing h1 specs, four h2 specs (two request weight 500, which is not loaded), eight uppercase-label tracking values (0.04em–0.24em), work/news/sold pages have no h1, contact h1 sits below the hero. - **Motion is effectively absent and inconsistent.** The only scroll reveal targets `.post-card`, which no live route renders, and it never re-binds after Swup navigation. The real gallery (`.legacy-page-frame`) has no reveal. The Swup wrapper runs a 0.9s/4vh slide on every load with no reduced-motion guard. Ten different transition durations and six easings are in use. Footer logo stroke-draw is positioned relative to `body` and hidden behind the content shell. - **Build-time bug.** `postcss-custom-properties({ preserve: false })` inlines `var()` inside `content.css`, silently breaking dark mode for global/buttons/forms and any new token cascade. - **Dead/duplicate CSS.** `legacy-gallery.css` imported nowhere; `hamburger.css` has no markup; `.post-content`, `.post-content-excerpt`, `.post-content-body`, `.page-head`, `.post-link` each defined 2–3 times; `.post-content-image` keeps a `translateX(calc(50vw - 50%))` after its margins were reset. **Outcome:** one token layer, one container, one type scale with clear roles, one motion language (shared ease/durations, scroll reveal on real content, consistent hover), verified with before/after screenshots at three widths. ## Interpretation and decisions (made, not open) - **Three reviews = three lenses, cumulative:** (1) layout/grid/consistency, (2) typography/hierarchy, (3) motion/interaction. Each: screenshot pass → findings file → implement → re-screenshot. - **Keep 62.5% root.** The ghost/content layer depends on it. Fix values through tokens instead. - **Container = 1180px for header, footer, and content.** Three of four surfaces are already 1180; the sticky logo should share a left edge with the hero eyebrow. Galleries may break out to 1440px. - **Remove `postcss-custom-properties`** from `postcss.config.cjs`. All targets support custom properties. - **About hero comes inside the container** with the standard large radius (it is the only edge-to-edge photo on the site). - **Footer logo watermark: fix and play on scroll**, shortened to ~3s. - **CTA pills keep mixed case** at `--text-sm` sans (their own "pill" role). The uppercase label spec applies to nav, footer nav, eyebrows, section labels, post-card titles. - **Work/news/sold** (placeholder pottery content) get the shared system (h1, prose width, one Instagram section) but are not removed. - **Brand direction unchanged.** Palette, fonts, arch hero, pill CTAs stay. ## Files (critical) - `src/styles/vars.css` — token layer - `src/styles/components/legacy-page.css` — home + all legacy routes (main visual surface) - `src/styles/components/site-shell.css` — header/footer - `src/styles/components/global.css` — body + heading scale + role classes - `src/styles/components/animations.css` — rewritten - `src/layouts/Layout.astro` + new `src/scripts/reveal.ts` — Swup init, reveal, aria-current - `src/components/LegacyHtmlPage.astro`, `InstagramGrid.astro`, `InstagramFeed.astro`, `Footer.astro`, `Header.astro`, `PostLayout.astro`, `PostCard.astro` - `src/pages/about-lovely-sunday.astro`, `src/templates/Contact.astro`, `src/templates/Work.astro` - `src/styles/content.css`, `layout.css`, `components/buttons.css`, `actions.css`, `forms.css` - `postcss.config.cjs` Build-gate constraints (must hold): ≤1 `

With the dev server up, I'm planning a capture script that sets the viewport for each route and width, waits for lazy images to load by scrolling through the page, strips out dev chrome, then grabs full-page and element-specific screenshots across the key routes like the homepage, lookbook, daily diary, about, and contact pages.

For details, I'm mapping out layout shots (header/hero alignment, pills row, footer, gallery), type shots (hero copy, nav, footer bio, post body), and motion shots capturing hover states and mid-transition frames. I'll start with 21 full-page captures across three widths and seven routes, then move to the detail shots, writing it all as a bash script.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Full-page baseline captures at three widths for the review routes.
set -u
BASE="http://127.0.0.1:4321"
OUT="${1:-.context/review-baseline}"
S="--session review"
mkdir -p "$OUT"

routes=(
  "/|home"
  "/lookbook|lookbook"
  "/lookbook/looks/babes-day|look"
  "/daily-diary|diary"
  "/about-lovely-sunday|about"
  "/contact-lovely-sunday|contact"
  "/work/minimal-forms|work"
)
widths=("1440 900" "768 1024" "390 844")

for w in "${widths[@]}"; do
  set -- $w
  agent-browser $S set viewport "$1" "$2" >/dev/null
  for r in "${routes[@]}"; do
    path="${r%%|*}"; name="${r##*|}"
    agent-browser $S open "$BASE$path" >/dev/null
    agent-browser $S wait 800 >/dev/null
    # trigger lazy images + reveal classes, then hide dev chrome
    agent-browser $S eval "(async()=>{const h=document.body.scrollHeight;for(let y=0;y<h;y+=600){window.scrollTo(0,y);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60));}window.scrollTo(0,0);document.querySelectorAll('.dev-bar,[data-agentation-host]').forEach(e=>e.remove());document.querySelectorAll('.post-card,[data-reveal]').forEach(e=>e.classList.add('is-visible'));})()" >/dev/null
    agent-browser $S wait 900 >/dev/null
    agent-browser $S screenshot --full "$OUT/${name}-${1}.png" >/dev/null
    echo "captured $name @ $1"
  done
done

![Header/hero guides](</Users/manikrathee/conductor/workspaces/lovely-sunday/barcelona-v2/.context/review-details/r1-home-header-hero-guides-1440.png>)
![Footer guides](</Users/manikrathee/conductor/workspaces/lovely-sunday/barcelona-v2/.context/review-details/r1-home-footer-guides-1440.png>)

The logo starts at x=78, the eyebrow and h1 at x=130, the footer brand at x=60. On the right, the nav ends at 1362 and the footer nav at 1380 while the hero image and gallery end at 1310. The 1px vertical guide line painted on `body` runs at x=130 and cuts through the footer without touching anything in the header. This is the single most visible inconsistency on the site: the sticky header and the hero never share an edge.

Cause: `.site-head-container` and `.site-foot-inner` are `max-width: 1320px` (`site-shell.css:54,179`); `.legacy-page` is `min(100%, 1180px)` (`legacy-page.css:2`); the footer has no inner padding so its brand sits at the outer 18px gutter.

### 1.2 — Post images are pushed 350px off-grid (High, bug)

![Work image](</Users/manikrathee/conductor/workspaces/lovely-sunday/barcelona-v2/.context/review-details/r1-work-image-offgrid-1440.png>)
![Contact image](</Users/manikrathee/conductor/workspaces/lovely-sunday/barcelona-v2/.context/review-details/r1-contact-image-offgrid-1440.png>)

Computed on `/work/minimal-forms`: `.post-content-image` has `transform: matrix(1,0,0,1,350,0)` and `width: 740px`, so it renders from 700 to 1440 while the prose column is 350 to 1090. The first rule at `content.css:148-156` sets `width: 75vw; min-width: 100%; margin-inline: calc(50% - 50vw); transform: translateX(calc(50vw - 50%))`; the "capture-faithful" override at `content.css:396-399` resets only the margin, leaving the translate. Affects work, news, sold, and contact.

### 1.3 — Lookbook gallery overflows the viewport instead of centering (High, bug)

![Lookbook breakout](</Users/manikrathee/conductor/workspaces/lovely-sunday/barcelona-v2/.context/review-details/r1-lookbook-gallery-breakout-1440.png>)

`.legacy-page--gallery .legacy-page-gallery { width: min(calc(100vw - 3rem), 1440px); justify-self: center }` (`legacy-page.css:175-178`) makes the gallery 1410px wide inside an 1180px grid column. `justify-self: center` cannot center an item wider than its area, so the gallery starts at x=130 and runs to x=1540. The right column is clipped by `html { overflow-x: hidden }`; a 100px slice of every right-hand photo is off screen at 1440. Same effect on `/daily-diary`.

### 1.4 — About page uses its own container and cancels site padding with fixed numbers (Medium)

![About hero](</Users/manikrathee/conductor/workspaces/lovely-sunday/barcelona-v2/.context/review-details/r1-about-hero-bleed-1440.png>)
![About grid](</Users/manikrathee/conductor/workspaces/lovely-sunday/barcelona-v2/.context/review-details/r1-about-grid-1440.png>)

`.about-inner` is `max-width: 1100px` with `1.2rem` padding (content edge x=170, a fifth left edge). The hero is edge-to-edge, the only full-bleed photo on the site, and it is achieved with `margin: -4rem -1.5rem 0` to undo `.site-main`'s `clamp(2.5rem,5vw,5rem) 1.5rem` padding; the numbers only match at one viewport width, so between 800 and 900px the hero overlaps the header by 1rem.

### 1.5 — CTA pills are pulled over the hero with a negative margin; on mobile the pull-up is arbitrary (Medium)

![Pills / gallery join](</Users/manikrathee/conductor/workspaces/lovely-sunday/barcelona-v2/.context/review-details/r1-home-pills-gallery-join-1440.png>)
![Pills 390](</Users/manikrathee/conductor/workspaces/lovely-sunday/barcelona-v2/.context/review-details/r1-home-pills-390.png>)

`.legacy-page--home .legacy-page-links { margin-top: clamp(-5rem, -5vw, -2rem) }` overrides the article's section gap so the pills sit 20–50px closer to the hero than any other section pair. The gap pills→gallery (about 60px) is then larger than the gap hero→pills. Vertical rhythm should come from one section-gap token, not per-block negative margins.

### 1.6 — Four radius values and a global image radius (Medium)

Computed: gallery frame images 12.5px; hero arch `140px 140px 12.5px 12.5px`; header logo **10px** (from `img { border-radius: 10px }` in `content.css:377`, which rounds the SVG wordmark and every icon); pills 999px; Instagram cards 8px; post cards 2px. Radius should live on media containers, from a three-step token, never on bare `img`.

### 1.7 — Gutters differ between shell and main (Low)

`.site-main` pads 15px, header/footer 18px, `.about-inner` 12px, `.instagram-feed` 10px. At 390px the hero copy starts at x=15 while the logo is centered and nav items are in a 4-column grid with 0 gap, so their text edges never meet the content edge either.

![Header 390](</Users/manikrathee/conductor/workspaces/lovely-sunday/barcelona-v2/.context/review-details/r1-home-header-390.png>)

### 1.8 — Dead and duplicate layout CSS (Low, hygiene)

- `legacy-gallery.css` is imported nowhere; `hamburger.css` has no markup.
- `.post-content` (720px then 74rem), `.post-content-excerpt`, `.post-content-body`, `.page-head`, `.post-link` are each defined 2–3 times across `content.css`, `layout.css`, `buttons.css`.
- `postcss-custom-properties({ preserve: false })` inlines every `var()` inside `content.css`, so dark-mode overrides and any new token cascade never reach those rules.
- Invalid CSS: `actions.css:58` `@media (max-width: var(--xsmall))`, `forms.css:19` `margin: 0 0 (var(--margin) * 0.5) 0`.

### 1.9 — Content note, not design: `/lookbook/looks/babes-day` renders the 404 capture

Two captures exist for that slug (a real "International Womens Day" page and a Squarespace 404 page) and the route currently picks the 404 one. Out of scope for this pass, but it makes the look template look broken in screenshots; use `/lookbook/looks/beretrainbow` for reviews.

## Recommendations

1. **One container token, header and footer included.** `--container: 118rem`, `--container-wide: 144rem`, `--container-prose: 72rem`, `--gutter: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 3.2rem)`. Header and footer inner become `max-width: calc(var(--container) + 2*var(--gutter)); padding-inline: var(--gutter)`. Content uses `.container` / `.container-prose`. The guide line is sized to the same token. Result: logo, eyebrow, h1, gallery, and footer brand share x=130 at 1440.
2. **Fix the two overflow bugs.** Delete the `75vw`/`translateX` rule for `.post-content-image` and keep one rule (`margin: 0 0 var(--space-6); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); overflow: hidden`). 3. **Spacing scale.** `--space-1…9` (0.4rem → 9.6rem on the 10px root) plus `--section-gap`, `--block-gap`, `--grid-gap`. Replace every negative margin and per-component clamp with these; remove the pills' negative margin and let the section gap carry the rhythm.
4. **Radius tokens on containers.** `--radius-sm/md/lg/pill`; apply to `.legacy-page-frame`, `.legacy-page-hero-media`, Instagram cards, `.post-content-image`; remove `img { border-radius }`. Keep the arch as the one signature exception.
5. **About page joins the system.** Hero inside `.container` with `--radius-lg`; `.about-inner` → `.container`; delete the negative-margin hack.
6. **Hygiene.** Remove `postcss-custom-properties`, delete dead files, collapse duplicate rules, fix the two invalid declarations, scope the global `button` rule.

## Implementation checklist

- [ ] `vars.css`: container, gutter, spacing, radius tokens
- [ ] `layout.css`: `.site-main` padding from tokens; `.container*` utilities
- [ ] `site-shell.css`: header/footer to `--container` + `--gutter`; guide line; footer inner padding
- [ ] `legacy-page.css`: container, gaps, breakout fix, radii on frames, pill margins
- [ ] `content.css`: post image fix, dedupe, drop `img` radius
- [ ] `about-lovely-sunday.astro`: container + hero
- [ ] `InstagramGrid.astro` / `InstagramFeed.astro`: width/gap/radius tokens; one Instagram section per post (`templates/Work.astro`)
- [ ] `postcss.config.cjs`, delete `legacy-gallery.css` + `hamburger.css`, fix `actions.css:58`, `forms.css:19`
- [ ] Re-capture with the same script; edges table should read 130 / 130 / 130 / 130

# Design Review 3 — Motion & interaction

**Lens:** What moves on load, on scroll, on hover, and between pages? Is there one easing and duration language? Does everything respect `prefers-reduced-motion`?
**Captured:** 2026-09-27. Hover states captured with `agent-browser hover` then screenshot; page transition captured 120ms after clicking a nav link; reduced motion checked with `set media light reduced-motion`.

## Inventory (computed at 1440)

| Element | Transition | Animation | Hover effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| `#swup` wrapper | `0.25s` (all) | `slideUp 0.9s` from 4vh, every load | — |
| Header nav link | `opacity .3s, color .3s`; `::after transform .25s` | — | accent + underline grows (good) |
| CTA pill | `border-color .25s, color .25s, transform .25s` | — | accent border + lift 1px |
| Gallery frame / image | none | — | **none** |
| Footer nav link | `opacity .3s, color .3s` | — | accent |
| Inline links | `color .4s` → `.2s` on hover | — | underline + accent |
| Instagram cards | `transform 180ms` / `220ms` | — | scale 1.03 |
| Post-card (unused) | `opacity .6s, transform .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)` | — | scale 1.02 |
| Footer logo stroke | — | `footer-logo-write 5.8s` on load | — |

Durations in use: 0.18, 0.2, 0.22, 0.25, 0.3, 0.4, 0.6, 0.9, 5.8s. Easings: `ease`, `ease-out`, `cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)`, `cubic-bezier(.075,.82,.165,1)`, `cubic-bezier(.67,.01,.38,.98)`.

Scroll reveal: `document.querySelectorAll('[data-reveal]').length` = 0, `.post-card` = 0, `.legacy-page-frame` = 12. **Nothing on the live site reveals on scroll.** The only observer (`Layout.astro:196-217`) targets `.post-card`, which no route renders, and it is bound once on `DOMContentLoaded` with no Swup rebind.

Reduced motion: with `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, `#swup` still reports `animation: slideUp 0.9s`, pills and nav still transition, and the footer logo still animates. Only the unused `.post-card` rule and the footer stroke have guards.

## Details

![Nav hover](</Users/manikrathee/conductor/workspaces/lovely-sunday/barcelona-v2/.context/review-details/r3-nav-hover-1440.png>)
![Pill hover](</Users/manikrathee/conductor/workspaces/lovely-sunday/barcelona-v2/.context/review-details/r3-pill-hover-1440.png>)
![Frame hover (no change)](</Users/manikrathee/conductor/workspaces/lovely-sunday/barcelona-v2/.context/review-details/r3-frame-hover-1440.png>)
![Footer hover](</Users/manikrathee/conductor/workspaces/lovely-sunday/barcelona-v2/.context/review-details/r3-footer-hover-1440.png>)
![Swup mid-transition, 120ms after click](</Users/manikrathee/conductor/workspaces/lovely-sunday/barcelona-v2/.context/review-details/r3-swup-mid-transition.png>)
![After Swup navigation to /lookbook](</Users/manikrathee/conductor/workspaces/lovely-sunday/barcelona-v2/.context/review-details/r3-swup-after-nav-lookbook.png>)

## Findings

### 3.1 — Page transition is a blank-out followed by a 0.9s slide (High)

120ms after clicking "Discover" the whole content area is empty cream (screenshot above): `html.is-animating .transition-fade { opacity: 0 }` drops everything, then the new page mounts and runs `slideUp` from 4vh (≈36px at 900 tall) over 0.9s with a very slow-out curve. A 4vh drift for almost a second on every page load, including the first, reads as lag rather than polish. The `transition: 0.25s` shorthand on the wrapper also animates every property, including layout ones.

### 3.2 — No scroll reveal anywhere on the live site (High)

The gallery frames, the hero, the CTA pills, the Instagram grid, and the footer all appear instantly. The one reveal system that exists targets a component (`PostCard`) that is only rendered in Storybook, and even there it would stay at `opacity: 0` after a Swup navigation because the observer is never rebound. The design intent (atelier-blush plan, step 10) called for cards fading in on scroll with a 0.6s ease-out and 0.1s stagger; that intent never reached the pages that ship.

### 3.3 — Photos have no hover state; the one image effect that exists is inconsistent (Medium)

Hovering a gallery frame (screenshot above) changes nothing. Instagram cards zoom 1.03 in 180ms in one component and 220ms in the other; the unused post-card zooms 1.02 in 600ms. The frames are `<figure>`s without links, so a zoom would be decorative only; but the Instagram cards and post images are links and should share one zoom spec. Radius currently sits on the `img`, so a zoom would break the rounded corners; Review 1 moves radius to the container to make this possible.

### 3.4 — Header active state is wrong and goes stale (Medium, bug)

After a Swup navigation to `/lookbook`, `.site-head-nav a[href='/lookbook']` has `aria-current = null`: the header is outside `#swup`, so the server-rendered attribute is never updated. Separately, the Contact link's `section` is `"/contact"` (`Header.astro:7`), which never matches `/contact-lovely-sunday`, so Contact is never highlighted even on a hard load.

### 3.5 — Footer logo stroke-draw plays off-screen and is never seen (Medium, bug)

`.site-foot-logo` is `position: absolute; inset: 0` inside `.site-foot`, which is `position: static`. Its containing block is `body`, so the logo box measures 0 → 3592px (the whole document) and sits behind the opaque `.site-content-shell`. The 5.8s stroke animation runs once on load, while the footer is 3000px below the fold. `--footer-reveal` is defined and unused; the intended reveal-footer effect was never finished.

### 3.6 — Ten durations, five easings, no tokens (Medium)

See inventory. Nav uses `.3s ease` for color but `.25s ease` for the underline; pills `.25s`; links `.4s` out / `.2s` in; Instagram 180/220ms; post-card 600ms with a custom curve. None of these reference a variable, so they cannot be tuned together and will keep drifting.

### 3.7 — Reduced motion is only partially honoured (Medium, accessibility)

With reduced motion on, the 0.9s slide, the pill lift, the nav underline, and the footer stroke still run. Only `.post-card` and `.site-foot-logo .st0` have `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` rules.

### 3.8 — Global `<button>` rule and `a:hover` underline fight component states (Low)

`buttons.css:4-8` styles every `<button>` as a dark 4rem block; the about page and dev bar re-override it. `global.css:350` underlines every link on hover, including the nav (which then hides it with `text-decoration: none`) and the pills.

## Recommendations

1. **Motion tokens in `vars.css`:** `--ease-out: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1)`, `--dur-fast 180ms`, `--dur-base 320ms`, `--dur-slow 700ms`, `--reveal-duration 600ms`, `--reveal-distance 12px`, `--hover-scale 1.02`. Replace every literal.
2. **Swup transition:** opacity + 12px over `--dur-base` with `--ease-out`; delete `slideUp`; no animation on first load.
3. **One reveal system.** `src/scripts/reveal.ts`: an `IntersectionObserver` over `[data-reveal]` (threshold .12, rootMargin `0 0 -8% 0`), batch-based stagger `min(i,6) × 50ms` via `--reveal-delay`, re-bound on Swup `page:view`. Gate with `html.reveal-ready` set by a sync inline script only when the observer exists and reduced motion is off, so nothing is ever hidden without JS. Apply `data-reveal` to hero copy children, hero media, each pill, each `.legacy-page-frame` (classes untouched for the build gate), Instagram header and cards, post header/image/body, about panels, footer inner.
4. **Hover language.** Media zoom `scale(1.02)` over `--dur-slow` on every linked image container (Instagram cards, post image, post card) and a gentler `1.01` on gallery frames; `.link-underline` extracted from the nav's `::after` grow and reused for footer nav and inline links; pills keep the 1px lift on `--dur-base`; buttons `--dur-fast`. Remove the global `a:hover` underline and scope the global `button` rule.
5. **Header state.** `updateAriaCurrent()` in the same script, prefix-matching `location.pathname` against `data-section`; fix Contact's section; keep the server-rendered attribute for no-JS.
6. **Footer watermark.** `.site-foot { position: relative; overflow: hidden }`, opacity ~0.1, stroke-draw shortened to 3.2s and `animation-play-state: paused` until `.site-foot.is-visible`.
7. **Reduced motion.** One block that neutralises reveal, Swup, hover transforms, and the footer stroke; verify Swup 4 does not stall when transition duration is zero (fallback 1ms).

## Implementation checklist

- [ ] `vars.css`: motion tokens
- [ ] `animations.css`: rewrite (Swup, reveal, reduced-motion, print)
- [ ] `src/scripts/reveal.ts` + `Layout.astro` (Swup init moves in; inline `reveal-ready` gate; remove old observer)
- [ ] `Header.astro`: `data-section`, fix Contact section
- [ ] `data-reveal` in `LegacyHtmlPage`, `InstagramGrid`, `InstagramFeed`, `PostLayout`, `Footer`, about page, `PostCard`
- [ ] `interaction.css`: media zoom, `.link-underline`, pills, buttons; sweep literals with `grep -rn "transition\|animation\|cubic-bezier" src`
- [ ] `site-shell.css`: footer positioning + paused stroke
- [ ] Verify: mid-transition frame is not blank; frames reveal after Swup nav; `aria-current` correct on `/lookbook` and `/contact-lovely-sunday`; reduced-motion → `reveal-ready` absent and frame opacity 1

# Design Review 3 — Motion & interaction

**Lens:** What moves on load, on scroll, on hover, and between pages? Is there one easing and duration language? Does everything respect `prefers-reduced-motion`?
**Captured:** 2026-09-27. Hover states captured with `agent-browser hover` then screenshot; page transition captured 120ms after clicking a nav link; reduced motion checked with `set media light reduced-motion`.

## Inventory (computed at 1440)

| Element | Transition | Animation | Hover effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| `#swup` wrapper | `0.25s` (all) | `slideUp 0.9s` from 4vh, every load | — |
| Header nav link | `opacity .3s, color .3s`; `::after transform .25s` | — | accent + underline grows (good) |
| CTA pill | `border-color .25s, color .25s, transform .25s` | — | accent border + lift 1px |
| Gallery frame / image | none | — | **none** |
| Footer nav link | `opacity .3s, color .3s` | — | accent |
| Inline links | `color .4s` → `.2s` on hover | — | underline + accent |
| Instagram cards | `transform 180ms` / `220ms` | — | scale 1.03 |
| Post-card (unused) | `opacity .6s, transform .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)` | — | scale 1.02 |
| Footer logo stroke | — | `footer-logo-write 5.8s` on load | — |

Durations in use: 0.18, 0.2, 0.22, 0.25, 0.3, 0.4, 0.6, 0.9, 5.8s. Easings: `ease`, `ease-out`, `cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)`, `cubic-bezier(.075,.82,.165,1)`, `cubic-bezier(.67,.01,.38,.98)`.

Scroll reveal: `document.querySelectorAll('[data-reveal]').length` = 0, `.post-card` = 0, `.legacy-page-frame` = 12. **Nothing on the live site reveals on scroll.** The only observer (`Layout.astro:196-217`) targets `.post-card`, which no route renders, and it is bound once on `DOMContentLoaded` with no Swup rebind.

Reduced motion: with `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, `#swup` still reports `animation: slideUp 0.9s`, pills and nav still transition, and the footer logo still animates. Only the unused `.post-card` rule and the footer stroke have guards.

## Details

![Nav hover](</Users/manikrathee/conductor/workspaces/lovely-sunday/barcelona-v2/.context/review-details/r3-nav-hover-1440.png>)
![Pill hover](</Users/manikrathee/conductor/workspaces/lovely-sunday/barcelona-v2/.context/review-details/r3-pill-hover-1440.png>)

## Findings

### 3.1 — Page transition is a blank-out followed by a 0.9s slide (High)

120ms after clicking "Discover" the whole content area is empty cream (screenshot above): `html.is-animating .transition-fade { opacity: 0 }` drops everything, then the new page mounts and runs `slideUp` from 4vh (≈36px at 900 tall) over 0.9s with a very slow-out curve. A 4vh drift for almost a second on every page load, including the first, reads as lag rather than polish. The `transition: 0.25s` shorthand on the wrapper also animates every property, including layout ones.

### 3.2 — No scroll reveal anywhere on the live site (High)

The gallery frames, the hero, the CTA pills, the Instagram grid, and the footer all appear instantly. The one reveal system that exists targets a component (`PostCard`) that is only rendered in Storybook, and even there it would stay at `opacity: 0` after a Swup navigation because the observer is never rebound. The design intent (atelier-blush plan, step 10) called for cards fading in on scroll with a 0.6s ease-out and 0.1s stagger; that intent never reached the pages that ship.

### 3.3 — Photos have no hover state; the one image effect that exists is inconsistent (Medium)

Hovering a gallery frame (screenshot above) changes nothing. Instagram cards zoom 1.03 in 180ms in one component and 220ms in the other; the unused post-card zooms 1.02 in 600ms. The frames are `<figure>`s without links, so a zoom would be decorative only; but the Instagram cards and post images are links and should share one zoom spec. Radius currently sits on the `img`, so a zoom would break the rounded corners; Review 1 moves radius to the container to make this possible.

### 3.4 — Header active state is wrong and goes stale (Medium, bug)

After a Swup navigation to `/lookbook`, `.site-head-nav a[href='/lookbook']` has `aria-current = null`: the header is outside `#swup`, so the server-rendered attribute is never updated. Separately, the Contact link's `section` is `"/contact"` (`Header.astro:7`), which never matches `/contact-lovely-sunday`, so Contact is never highlighted even on a hard load.

### 3.5 — Footer logo stroke-draw plays off-screen and is never seen (Medium, bug)

`.site-foot-logo` is `position: absolute; inset: 0` inside `.site-foot`, which is `position: static`. Its containing block is `body`, so the logo box measures 0 → 3592px (the whole document) and sits behind the opaque `.site-content-shell`. The 5.8s stroke animation runs once on load, while the footer is 3000px below the fold. `--footer-reveal` is defined and unused; the intended reveal-footer effect was never finished.

### 3.6 — Ten durations, five easings, no tokens (Medium)

See inventory. Nav uses `.3s ease` for color but `.25s ease` for the underline; pills `.25s`; links `.4s` out / `.2s` in; Instagram 180/220ms; post-card 600ms with a custom curve. None of these reference a variable, so they cannot be tuned together and will keep drifting.

### 3.7 — Reduced motion is only partially honoured (Medium, accessibility)

With reduced motion on, the 0.9s slide, the pill lift, the nav underline, and the footer stroke still run. Only `.post-card` and `.site-foot-logo .st0` have `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` rules.

### 3.8 — Global `<button>` rule and `a:hover` underline fight component states (Low)

`buttons.css:4-8` styles every `<button>` as a dark 4rem block; the about page and dev bar re-override it. `global.css:350` underlines every link on hover, including the nav (which then hides it with `text-decoration: none`) and the pills.

## Recommendations

1. **Motion tokens in `vars.css`:** `--ease-out: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1)`, `--dur-fast 180ms`, `--dur-base 320ms`, `--dur-slow 700ms`, `--reveal-duration 600ms`, `--reveal-distance 12px`, `--hover-scale 1.02`. Replace every literal.
2. **Swup transition:** opacity + 12px over `--dur-base` with `--ease-out`; delete `slideUp`; no animation on first load.
3. **One reveal system.** `src/scripts/reveal.ts`: an `IntersectionObserver` over `[data-reveal]` (threshold .12, rootMargin `0 0 -8% 0`), batch-based stagger `min(i,6) × 50ms` via `--reveal-delay`, re-bound on Swup `page:view`. Gate with `html.reveal-ready` set by a sync inline script only when the observer exists and reduced motion is off, so nothing is ever hidden without JS. Apply `data-reveal` to hero copy children, hero media, each pill, each `.legacy-page-frame` (classes untouched for the build gate), Instagram header and cards, post header/image/body, about panels, footer inner.
4. **Hover language.** Media zoom `scale(1.02)` over `--dur-slow` on every linked image container (Instagram cards, post image, post card) and a gentler `1.01` on gallery frames; `.link-underline` extracted from the nav's `::after` grow and reused for footer nav and inline links; pills keep the 1px lift on `--dur-base`; buttons `--dur-fast`. Remove the global `a:hover` underline and scope the global `button` rule.
5. **Header state.** `updateAriaCurrent()` in the same script, prefix-matching `location.pathname` against `data-section`; fix Contact's section; keep the server-rendered attribute for no-JS.
6. **Footer watermark.** `.site-foot { position: relative; overflow: hidden }`, opacity ~0.1, stroke-draw shortened to 3.2s and `animation-play-state: paused` until `.site-foot.is-visible`.
7. **Reduced motion.** One block that neutralises reveal, Swup, hover transforms, and the footer stroke; verify Swup 4 does not stall when transition duration is zero (fallback 1ms).

## Implementation checklist

- [ ] `vars.css`: motion tokens
- [ ] `animations.css`: rewrite (Swup, reveal, reduced-motion, print)
- [ ] `src/scripts/reveal.ts` + `Layout.astro` (Swup init moves in; inline `reveal-ready` gate; remove old observer)
- [ ] `Header.astro`: `data-section`, fix Contact section
- [ ] `data-reveal` in `LegacyHtmlPage`, `InstagramGrid`, `InstagramFeed`, `PostLayout`, `Footer`, about page, `PostCard`
- [ ] `interaction.css`: media zoom, `.link-underline`, pills, buttons; sweep literals with `grep -rn "transition\|animation\|cubic-bezier" src`
- [ ] `site-shell.css`: footer positioning + paused stroke
- [ ] Verify: mid-transition frame is not blank; frames reveal after Swup nav; `aria-current` correct on `/lookbook` and `/contact-lovely-sunday`; reduced-motion → `reveal-ready` absent and frame opacity 1

# Three design reviews + implementation: consistency, grid, hierarchy, motion ## Context Lovely Sunday (lovelysunday.co) is an Astro 5 static site: a photography-led personal style journal in the "Atelier Blush" direction (cream `#FAF7F2`, dusty rose, gold accent `#C4A265`, Cormorant Garamond display). Commit `6a5f1ce` redesigned the homepage and nav page-by-page, so the shared system is now inconsistent. Verified problems: - **No token system.** `vars.css` has colors and fonts only. No spacing, type, container, radius, or motion tokens. Breakpoint vars exist but are unused (and `actions.css:58` uses one inside `@media`, which is invalid CSS). - **Five container widths.** Header/footer 1320px; `.legacy-page`/Instagram/guide line 1180px; `.post-feed`/`InstagramFeed` 1120px; about page 1100px; prose 720px→740px. `.site-main` has fixed `1.5rem` side padding while header/footer use `clamp(1rem,2vw,1.8rem)`. No two edges line up. - **Two rem assumptions.** `html { font-size: 62.5% }` (1rem = 10px), but newer CSS was written for 16px: legacy body copy is **10.2px**, home hero paragraph 10–12px, eyebrow/nav/footer nav 10px (9px on mobile), footer bio 9.5px. Post body copy is 20px. Same site, half and double the intended size. - **Hierarchy conflicts.** Four competing h1 specs, four h2 specs (two request weight 500, which is not loaded), eight uppercase-label tracking values (0.04em–0.24em), work/news/sold pages have no h1, contact h1 sits below the hero. - **Motion is effectively absent and inconsistent.** The only scroll reveal targets `.post-card`, which no live route renders, and it never re-binds after Swup navigation. The real gallery (`.legacy-page-frame`) has no reveal. The Swup wrapper runs a 0.9s/4vh slide on every load with no reduced-motion guard. Ten different transition durations and six easings are in use. Footer logo stroke-draw is positioned relative to `body` and hidden behind the content shell. - **Build-time bug.** `postcss-custom-properties({ preserve: false })` inlines `var()` inside `content.css`, silently breaking dark mode for global/buttons/forms and any new token cascade. - **Dead/duplicate CSS.** `legacy-gallery.css` imported nowhere; `hamburger.css` has no markup; `.post-content`, `.post-content-excerpt`, `.post-content-body`, `.page-head`, `.post-link` each defined 2–3 times; `.post-content-image` keeps a `translateX(calc(50vw - 50%))` after its margins were reset. **Outcome:** one token layer, one container, one type scale with clear roles, one motion language (shared ease/durations, scroll reveal on real content, consistent hover), verified with before/after screenshots at three widths. ## Interpretation and decisions (made, not open) - **Three reviews = three lenses, cumulative:** (1) layout/grid/consistency, (2) typography/hierarchy, (3) motion/interaction. Each: screenshot pass → findings file → implement → re-screenshot. - **Keep 62.5% root.** The ghost/content layer depends on it. Fix values through tokens instead. - **Container = 1180px for header, footer, and content.** Three of four surfaces are already 1180; the sticky logo should share a left edge with the hero eyebrow. # Implement all three design reviews behind a runtime "design stage" toggle

## Context

Three design reviews are complete and documented with measured findings and screenshots:

- `.context/design-review-1.md` — Layout, grid & consistency (5 container widths, header/footer/content on different edges, post image translated 350px off-column, lookbook gallery overflowing the viewport, about-page negative-margin hack, four radius values, dead/duplicate CSS, broken PostCSS token inlining)
- `.context/design-review-2.md` — Typography & hierarchy (legacy body copy 10.2px vs post body 20px because `html { font-size: 62.5% }` meets 16px-assumed rem values; nav 10px/9px; footer bio 9.5px; four h1 and four h2 specs; work/news/sold have no h1; eight uppercase-label tracking values)
- `.context/design-review-3.md` — Motion & interaction (page transition blanks the screen then slides 4vh for 0.9s; no scroll reveal on any live route; no photo hover; header active state wrong and stale after Swup; footer logo animates off-screen; ten durations / five easings; reduced motion ignored)

The user wants **all of it implemented**, plus **a toggle on the web preview to switch between the versions** until they choose a winner. So the three passes must be switchable at runtime, not committed as one irreversible restyle.

## Architecture: additive stage layers on `<html data-design>`

- Baseline CSS stays as-is (that is "v0", the honest current state).
- Each review becomes a **stage stylesheet** whose every selector is prefixed with `html[data-design~="vN"]`:
  - `src/styles/stages/v1-layout.css`
  - `src/styles/stages/v2-type.css`
  - `src/styles/stages/v3-motion.css`
- `<html data-design="v1 v2 v3">` enables all three; the `~=` attribute selector lets each stage be toggled **independently** (Layout / Type / Motion switches) as well as via presets (Baseline, Layout, Layout+Type, All). This covers both readings of "switch between them".
- Tokens go into `vars.css` unconditionally (they are inert until a stage rule reads them).
- **Markup is identical across stages.** Anything structural (post h1, `data-reveal`, `data-section`, footer wrapper) is added once and only *styled/activated* by a stage; where a structural addition is visible on baseline (the new post h1), it is hidden under `html:not([data-design~="v2"])`.
- Stage is chosen by a sync inline script in `<Head>` (reads `localStorage["lovely-sunday:design"]`, default `"v1 v2 v3"`) so there is no flash. A `DesignStageToggle.astro` (fixed pill, bottom-centre) renders in dev and when `PUBLIC_DESIGN_TOGGLE=1`, writes localStorage, updates the attribute in place, and dispatches `design:change` so the motion script rebinds without a reload.
- Later, once a winner is chosen, flattening is mechanical: drop the prefix from the winning stage files and delete the losing ones. Note this in the summary.

Build-gate constraints still hold: ≤1 `<h1>` per page, keep `.legacy-page-gallery`, `.legacy-page-frame`, `.is-half-span`, `img[data-image-dimensions]`, no `sqs-`/`agentation` strings in classes, Storybook prop names unchanged.

## Files

**New**
- `src/styles/stages/v1-layout.css`, `v2-type.css`, `v3-motion.css`
- `src/components/DesignStageToggle.astro`
- `src/scripts/reveal.ts` (Swup init + reveal + aria-current; stage-aware)

**Modified**
- `src/styles/vars.css` — tokens (spacing, type, containers, radii, motion, z)
- `src/layouts/Layout.astro` — import stage CSS, inline stage/reveal gate, mount toggle, move Swup init to `reveal.ts`, remove old `.post-card` observer
- `src/components/LegacyHtmlPage.astro`, `InstagramGrid.astro`, `InstagramFeed.astro`, `Footer.astro`, `Header.astro`, `PostLayout.astro`, `PostCard.astro` — `data-reveal`, `data-section`, h1, class hooks (`.eyebrow`, `.section-title`, `.container`)
- `src/pages/about-lovely-sunday.astro`, `src/templates/Contact.astro`, `src/templates/Work.astro` — heading roles, container hooks, single Instagram section
- `postcss.config.cjs` — remove `postcss-custom-properties` (global; required for any token to cascade)
- `src/styles/content.css` — remove `@import "vars.css"` and `hamburger.css`; fix invalid `actions.css:58`, `forms.css:19`; delete `legacy-gallery.css`, `hamburger.css` (dead, all stages)

## Step 0 — Foundation (all stages)

1. `postcss.config.cjs`: drop `postcss-custom-properties`. `content.css`: drop the duplicate `vars.css` import and `hamburger.css` import. Delete `hamburger.css`, `legacy-gallery.css`. Fix `actions.css:58` → `@media (max-width: 480px)`; `forms.css:19` → `margin: 0 0 1rem 0`.

   - type `--text-xs 1.1rem`, `--text-sm 1.4rem`, `--text-md clamp(1.6rem,1.5rem+.25vw,1.8rem)`, `--text-lg clamp(1.8rem,1.6rem+.5vw,2.1rem)`, `--text-xl clamp(2.2rem,1.8rem+1vw,2.8rem)`, `--text-2xl clamp(2.8rem,2rem+2vw,4rem)`, `--text-3xl clamp(3.6rem,2.4rem+3vw,5.4rem)`, `--text-display clamp(4.4rem,2.8rem+5.5vw,8rem)`, `--leading-tight 1.02`, `--leading-snug 1.2`, `--leading-body 1.7`, `--tracking-label .18em`, `--tracking-display -.02em`
   - containers `--container 118rem`, `--container-wide 144rem`, `--container-prose 72rem`, `--gutter clamp(1.6rem,3vw,3.2rem)`
   - radii `--radius-sm .4rem`, `--radius-md .8rem`, `--radius-lg 1.2rem`, `--radius-pill 999px`
   - motion `--ease-out cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)`, `--dur-fast 180ms`, `--dur-base 320ms`, `--dur-slow 700ms`, `--reveal-duration 600ms`, `--reveal-distance 12px`, `--hover-scale 1.02`

4. `DesignStageToggle.astro`: three switches (Layout, Type, Motion) + presets (Baseline / All); persists; updates attribute; toggles `reveal-ready`; dispatches `design:change`. - Radius on containers: `.legacy-page-frame, .legacy-page-hero-media { border-radius: var(--radius-lg); overflow: hidden; background: var(--color-bg-subtle) }`, imgs `border-radius: 0`; home arch `14rem 14rem var(--radius-lg) var(--radius-lg)`; `img { border-radius: 0 }` (undo global), `.site-head-logo img { border-radius: 0 }`
- Pills: `.legacy-page--home .legacy-page-links { margin-top: 0 }`; ≤640px single-column, centered
- **Post image fix:** `.post-content-image { width: auto; min-width: 0; margin: 0 0 var(--space-6); transform: none; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); overflow: hidden }`; `.post-content, .contact-form { width: min(100%, var(--container-prose)); max-width: none; padding: 0 }`

# Implement all three design reviews behind a runtime "design stage" toggle

## Context

Three design reviews are complete and documented with measured findings and screenshots:

- `.context/design-review-1.md` — Layout, grid & consistency (5 container widths, header/footer/content on different edges, post image translated 350px off-column, lookbook gallery overflowing the viewport, about-page negative-margin hack, four radius values, dead/duplicate CSS, broken PostCSS token inlining)
- `.context/design-review-2.md` — Typography & hierarchy (legacy body copy 10.2px vs post body 20px because `html { font-size: 62.5% }` meets 16px-assumed rem values; nav 10px/9px; footer bio 9.5px; four h1 and four h2 specs; work/news/sold have no h1; eight uppercase-label tracking values)
- `.context/design-review-3.md` — Motion & interaction (page transition blanks the screen then slides 4vh for 0.9s; no scroll reveal on any live route; no photo hover; header active state wrong and stale after Swup; footer logo animates off-screen; ten durations / five easings; reduced motion ignored)

The user wants **all of it implemented**, plus **a toggle on the web preview to switch between the versions** until they choose a winner. So the three passes must be switchable at runtime, not committed as one irreversible restyle.

## Architecture: additive stage layers on `<html data-design>`

- Baseline CSS stays as-is (that is "v0", the honest current state).
- Each review becomes a **stage stylesheet** whose every selector is prefixed with `html[data-design~="vN"]`:
  - `src/styles/stages/v1-layout.css`
  - `src/styles/stages/v2-type.css`
  - `src/styles/stages/v3-motion.css`
- `<html data-design="v1 v2 v3">` enables all three; the `~=` attribute selector lets each stage be toggled **independently** (Layout / Type / Motion switches) as well as via presets (Baseline, Layout, Layout+Type, All). This covers both readings of "switch between them".
- Tokens go into `vars.css` unconditionally (they are inert until a stage rule reads them).
- **Markup is identical across stages.** Anything structural (post h1, `data-reveal`, `data-section`, footer wrapper) is added once and only *styled/activated* by a stage; where a structural addition is visible on baseline (the new post h1), it is hidden under `html:not([data-design~="v2"])`.
- Stage is chosen by a sync inline script in `<Head>` (reads `localStorage["lovely-sunday:design"]`, default `"v1 v2 v3"`) so there is no flash. A `DesignStageToggle.astro` (fixed pill, bottom-centre) renders in dev and when `PUBLIC_DESIGN_TOGGLE=1`, writes localStorage, updates the attribute in place, and dispatches `design:change` so the motion script rebinds without a reload.
- Later, once a winner is chosen, flattening is mechanical: drop the prefix from the winning stage files and delete the losing ones. Note this in the summary.

Build-gate constraints still hold: ≤1 `<h1>` per page, keep `.legacy-page-gallery`, `.legacy-page-frame`, `.is-half-span`, `img[data-image-dimensions]`, no `sqs-`/`agentation` strings in classes, Storybook prop names unchanged.

## Files

**New**
- `src/styles/stages/v1-layout.css`, `v2-type.css`, `v3-motion.css`
- `src/components/DesignStageToggle.astro`
- `src/scripts/reveal.ts` (Swup init + reveal + aria-current; stage-aware)

**Modified**
- `src/styles/vars.css` — tokens (spacing, type, containers, radii, motion, z)
- `src/layouts/Layout.astro` — import stage CSS, inline stage/reveal gate, mount toggle, move Swup init to `reveal.ts`, remove old `.post-card` observer
- `src/components/LegacyHtmlPage.astro`, `InstagramGrid.astro`, `InstagramFeed.astro`, `Footer.astro`, `Header.astro`, `PostLayout.astro`, `PostCard.astro` — `data-reveal`, `data-section`, h1, class hooks (`.eyebrow`, `.section-title`, `.container`)
- `src/pages/about-lovely-sunday.astro`, `src/templates/Contact.astro`, `src/templates/Work.astro` — heading roles, container hooks, single Instagram section
- `postcss.config.cjs` — remove `postcss-custom-properties` (global; required for any token to cascade)
